user.title: Vimar Intercom
user.description: Add the Vimar Elvox video intercom. SIP credentials are built-in.

qr.title: Scan pairing QR code
qr.description: Paste the text of the pairing QR code printed on the intercom box. On error: {error_detail}

data_description.qr_text: The textual content of the QR code (e.g. ID=12345&PROXY=...).

manual.title: SIP credentials
manual.description: Enter the SIP credentials for your Vimar intercom.

data_description.sip_user: The numeric SIP ID of your intercom.
data_description.sip_password: The SIP password (visible in the pairing QR code).
data_description.sip_domain: The Vimar cloud SIP domain (e.g. ipvdes.vimar.cloud).
data_description.cloud_proxy: The cloud SIP proxy. Default: ipvdes.vimar.cloud.

network.title: Local network
network.description: Enter the local IP of the intercom. A SIP registration test will be performed. User: {sip_user}@{sip_domain} — MAC: {mac}. On error: {error_detail}

data_description.local_proxy: The local IP address of your Vimar intercom (e.g. 192.168.1.100).
data_description.use_local_udp: Enable local UDP mode. Requires HA and the intercom to be on the same network.
data_description.local_udp_port: UDP port used by HA for local SIP. Default: 5060.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Vimar intercom found on the network
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found a Vimar intercom at {host} (MAC {mac}, model {model}, firmware {firmware}). To connect it you still need the pairing QR code or the SIP credentials: the address and the local domain are already filled in.

error.sip_registration_failed: SIP registration failed. Check that the intercom IP is correct and reachable from HA.

abort.no_mac: The intercom announced itself without a MAC: add it by hand from Settings → Devices & services.

menu_options.fetch_rubrica: Download the phonebook from the intercom
menu_options.fetch_rubrica_cloud: Download the phonebook from the Vimar cloud

settings.title: Vimar Intercom settings
settings.description: SIP network and dynamic actuators. In the Actuators field paste the JSON list produced by tools/parse_rubrica.py, or go back to the menu and use "Import actuators from rubrica.db". {actuators_error}

data.camera_target: Video entrance panel (SIP id to call)
data.door_target: Entrance panel that opens the door
data.away_message_text: Message if nobody answers (text, read by TTS)
data.away_message_delay: After how many seconds of ringing (0 = never)
data.snapshot_delay: Seconds for the better snapshot (0 = first only)
data.allowed_users: Users allowed to see rings and live media (empty = everyone)

data_description.media_enc: Automatic: follows what the system declares in its GET_INIT_STATUS reply ("media_enc": "srtp" on a cloud Tab 5S Up 40515); when the system does not declare it (short reply, as on the 40507) media stays plain. On/Off force it. If the camera stays black or the call fails with 488, try On.
data_description.actuators: JSON list of objects name, msg, target, icon. icon: door|light|switch. target "AUTO" uses the panel that opens the door. Empty = no buttons.
data_description.sga_target: Target for VOICEMAIL;/DND;, and for the door-open command when “Entrance panel that opens the door” is empty. Empty = historical default (55001). Change it only if your system uses a different SGA (SYSTEM.MAGIC_APT_INTERCOM in rubrica.db).
data_description.picg_target: Target for GET_INIT_STATUS. On systems verified so far it matches the SGA. Empty = historical default (55001).
data_description.camera_target: Panel called by the camera, by “Chiama” and by “Chiama Video (esterno)”: the PHONEBOOK row with TYPE='PE' in rubrica.db (the phonebook import fills it in). Empty = historical default (55100). This is not the SGA.
data_description.internal_panel_target: Target of the “Chiama Casa (interno)” button. The phonebook does not say which one it is: enter it by hand. Empty = historical default (55002).
data_description.door_target: Where the door-open command goes: the GID_PE of the door actuator in the phonebook (on a 2FV2 it is not the SGA). Filled in by importing or downloading the phonebook. Empty = the door actuator's panel if actuators were imported, otherwise the SGA.
data_description.away_message_file: Audio file (mp3, wav...) played to the visitor when nobody answers, e.g. /config/media/citofono/messaggio.mp3. Empty = off.
data_description.away_message_text: Text read to the visitor by Home Assistant's text-to-speech when the file field is empty (the file takes precedence). In HA's language, max 30 s of audio. Empty = off.
data_description.away_message_tts: TTS entity that reads the text (e.g. tts.google_translate_en_com, tts.piper). Empty = HA's default TTS engine. If synthesis fails the doorbell keeps ringing as usual.
data_description.away_message_delay: If it is still ringing after this many seconds (nobody answered from the panel, phone or HA), the integration answers, plays the file and hangs up. Keep it shorter than the Tab's own voicemail, if enabled. 0 = never.
data_description.snapshot_dir: Folder where the visitor's snapshot (squillo_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_mmm.jpg and ultimo_squillo.jpg) and the ring clip (.mp4, up to 60 s) are saved, e.g. /config/media/citofono. Must be in allowlist_external_dirs or a media folder. Empty = do not save.
data_description.snapshot_delay: The first snapshot is saved as soon as the first frame arrives (~1 s after the ring); after this many seconds it is replaced by a frame with the exposure settled (the panel's first one is dark). 3 s suits the Tab 5S Up 40515; increase it if snapshots come out dark, 0 = keep the first.
data_description.allowed_users: Limits the card, the ring history (photos and clips) and /audio_ws to these Home Assistant users. Admins always. Empty = every logged-in user. It does NOT limit the camera entity or /av from the local network: anyone who can open the camera sees (and hears) the stream; and if the photo folder is under an HA media directory, photos and clips show up in the media browser for every user.
data_description.ring_webhook_url: GET (fire-and-forget) sent when a ring starts, e.g. to turn on a dummy switch (Scrypted Dummy Switch) linked to a Custom Doorbell Button. A failure is only logged as a warning and never stops the ring. Empty = off.
data_description.ring_end_webhook_url: GET (fire-and-forget) sent when the ring ends, answered, cancelled or timed out: same idea as above, to turn the switch off. Empty = off.

import_rubrica.title: Import from rubrica.db
import_rubrica.description: Upload the rubrica.db file extracted from the system (see docs/RUBRICA.md): the integration automatically derives your apartment's actuators, without manually copying the output of tools/parse_rubrica.py. The file is read read-only and is not kept by Home Assistant after import. {rubrica_error}

data_description.rubrica_gid: The apartment's GID in the phonebook (usually the one already in use, e.g. 101).

import_confirm.title: Confirm import

fetch_rubrica.title: Download from the intercom
fetch_rubrica.description:
Asks the intercom ({host}) for the phonebook directly, using the SIP credentials already configured: no manual extraction and no Vimar account needed. The same request also asks for the PICG, which the intercom reports itself.

This works when the intercom is reachable on the local network; if it does not answer, use "Import actuators from rubrica.db". {rubrica_error}

data_description.rubrica_gid: The apartment GID in the phonebook (usually the one already in use, e.g. 101).

fetch_rubrica_cloud.title: Download from the Vimar cloud
fetch_rubrica_cloud.description: Downloads the phonebook from {cproxy} with the token the system sends in its GET_INIT_STATUS reply: it is the same rubrica.db file the VIEW app uses. Only for systems that send the long reply (seen on a Tab 5S Up 40515 / 2FV2); the token is not stored. {rubrica_error}

data_description.rubrica_gid: The apartment GID in the phonebook (the one the system declares is proposed).

error.invalid_actuator_target: Invalid actuator target ({actuators_error}): digits only (e.g. 55001) or AUTO.
error.rubrica_import_failed: Import failed. See description above for details.
error.rubrica_no_actuators: No actuators found for the specified GID. See description above.
error.no_local_proxy: The intercom address is missing: set it under "Network settings and actuators".
error.rest_auth_failed: The intercom rejected the SIP credentials, or does not expose this API. Note: it answers 401 in both cases.
error.rest_unavailable: The intercom is not reachable over HTTP on the local network. If the system only works through the cloud, use the file import instead.
error.file_not_allowed: File outside the folders Home Assistant may read: add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs or use a media folder.
error.file_not_found: File not found: use the full path, e.g. /config/media/citofono/messaggio.mp3.
error.path_not_allowed: Home Assistant cannot write to this folder: add it to allowlist_external_dirs or use a media folder.
error.path_public: Public folder: /config/www is served on /local without login. Use e.g. /config/media/citofono.
error.no_cloud_token: This system did not send the phonebook token (short GET_INIT_STATUS reply, as on the 40507): use “Download the phonebook from the intercom” or “Import actuators from rubrica.db”.
error.cloud_auth_failed: The Vimar cloud rejected the token.
error.cloud_failed: Phonebook download from the cloud failed.

send_command.name: Send SIP command
send_command.description: Send an arbitrary SIP MESSAGE to the intercom (for testing commands).

call.name: Call
call.description: Start a call to an entry panel or monitor.

simulate_ring.name: Test ring
simulate_ring.description: Simulate a doorbell ring (doorbell event and automations) without the entrance panel.

open_door.name: Open door
open_door.description: Send the door-open command to the entry panel.

target.name: Entry panel
target.description: Entry panel SIP ID. Empty = the panel that opens the door (from the phonebook), otherwise the SGA.

fetch_local.name: Local HTTP fetch
fetch_local.description: GET (Digest sipID/password) to the intercom's local web interface. Admins only.

host.name: Host
host.description: Private or loopback IP (default: the intercom)

find_sga.name: Find SGA/PICG
find_sga.description: Sends GET_NICKS (Panda: blue) to the given addresses one at a time and stops when the intercom answers with GET_NICKS_REPLY: the entry with role PICG is the system's group head. Use it when you don't know the SGA and have no phonebook (cloud-only systems, issue #14). On the reference system GET_NICKS raises no notification in the app; on others this is not verified yet. It does not change the configuration unless you choose Apply.

end.name: Last address
end.description: End of the range (inclusive). At most 50 addresses.

targets.name: Specific addresses
targets.description: Instead of the range, a comma-separated list (e.g. 55001, 55002, 55100). If set, start/end are ignored.

delay.name: Pause between probes
delay.description: Seconds between one probe and the next.

reply_wait.name: Reply wait
reply_wait.description: Seconds to wait for GET_NICKS_REPLY after each accepted probe.

apply.name: Apply as PICG
apply.description: If found, write it to picg_target (the integration reloads).

apply_sga.name: Also apply as SGA
apply_sga.description: If found, also write the same address to sga_target (target of voicemail, do-not-disturb and door opening). They matched on every system seen so far, but they are two distinct values.

probe.name: Probe
probe.description: get_nicks (default) raises no notification in the app and its reply names the PICG. get_init_status is the fallback for systems where get_nicks times out: it gives the three clean outcomes, but sent to the real SGA it makes the app show "Configurazione appartamento modificata" every time.

sip_timeout.name: SIP timeout per probe
sip_timeout.description: How long to wait for each probe's SIP answer (200/404) before moving on.
